mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases to counter economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals intensifying economic distress, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve policy easing that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales signal a severe aggregate demand shock, triggering aggressive monetary policy response that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and GDPC1 growth < 0.5% annualized), a decline in industrial production signals intensifying economic contraction, prompting Federal Reserve policy easing that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive in recession regimes when INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in nonfarm payrolls signals worsening labor market conditions, which typically precedes deeper economic contraction and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts exceeding 10% over three months signals severe housing market collapse, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST falls > 10% in 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signals aggressive monetary easing, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as policy response materializes.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL < 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), a decline in industrial production signals supply shock stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy constraint concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative in high inflation regimes when INDPRO declines (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC > -0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
